waker.note_zh: 這些答案說的是一般的豆子，用的是和模型同一套簡單的規則。不同的植物，需要的條件不一樣。

facts.eyebrow: Seeds by the Numbers · 種子的數字
facts.zh: 六個和種子有關的數字
facts.lead_en: How many things they need, how small they can be, and how long they can wait.
facts.lead_zh: 它們需要幾樣東西、可以多小、可以等多久。

items.en: A coat, a tiny plant, and stored food.
items.zh: 種皮、一株小植物，還有存好的養分。

items.en: Water, the right warmth, and air. Some seeds also need light or darkness.
items.zh: 水、合適的溫度和空氣。有些種子還需要光，或需要黑暗。

items.en: The root is the first part to come out of a seed.
items.zh: 從種子裡最先出來的是根。

items.en: Orchid seeds are the smallest of all. They are like dust, and about a million of them weigh one gram.
items.zh: 蘭花的種子是所有種子裡最小的，像灰塵一樣，大約一百萬顆才一公克重。

items.en: A sacred lotus seed this old, found in a dry lake bed in northeastern China, was still able to grow.
items.zh: 在中國東北一處乾涸的湖底找到的一顆古蓮子，這麼老了還能發芽生長。

items.en: A date palm seed about this old was sprouted by scientists in 2005.
items.zh: 2005 年，科學家讓一顆大約這麼老的椰棗種子發了芽。

culture_cards.title_en: An old jar, a tilted pot, a white vegetable, and a cold room in Taichung
culture_cards.title_zh: 一個古老的罐子、一盆放倒的植物、一種白色的蔬菜，還有台中的一間冷房
culture_cards.lead_en: What seeds can wait for, and what people have learned from them.
culture_cards.lead_zh: 種子等得了什麼，人們又從它們身上學到了什麼。

cards.body_en: In the 1960s, people digging at Masada, an ancient palace in a very dry part of Israel, found date palm seeds in an old jar. Tests showed that the seeds were about two thousand years old. In 2005, a team of scientists planted one, and it sprouted. The palm that grew from it was named Methuselah.
cards.body_zh: 1960 年代，考古人員在以色列非常乾燥的地區挖掘古代宮殿馬薩達，在一個古老的罐子裡發現了椰棗的種子。檢驗的結果顯示，這些種子大約有兩千年那麼老。2005 年，一組科學家種下其中一顆，它發芽了。長出來的那棵椰棗樹被取名為「瑪土撒拉」。

cards.body_en: Charles Darwin was one of the first people to study this carefully, and he wrote that roots grow toward the pull of gravity while stems grow away from it. You can see it with a potted plant. Lay the pot on its side, and in time the growing tip of the stem turns and points up again. Inside the tip of a root, tiny heavy grains of starch settle to the low side and tell the root which way is down.
cards.body_zh: 達爾文是最早仔細研究這件事的人之一。他記錄下：根順著重力的方向長，莖背著重力的方向長。用一盆植物就看得到：把花盆放倒，過一陣子，莖正在生長的頂端會轉個彎，重新朝上。在根的尖端裡面，有一些又小又重的澱粉粒會沉到低的那一邊，告訴根哪邊是下面。

cards.body_en: Bean sprouts are mung beans that have been sprouted in the shade and watered until the stem grows long. A seedling kept from the light does not make the green substance in its leaves. It puts everything into a long, pale stem. In nature this helps a buried seedling to reach the surface. In the kitchen, it gives us a crisp white vegetable.
cards.body_zh: 豆芽是在遮光的地方發芽的綠豆，一直澆水，直到莖長得長長的。見不到光的小苗不會製造葉子裡那種綠色的物質，而是把力氣全用在一根又長又白的莖上。在野外，這能幫助埋在土裡的小苗鑽到地面；在廚房裡，它給了我們一種又脆又白的蔬菜。

cards.zh: 一座沉睡種子的圖書館
cards.body_en: In Wufeng, Taichung, the Taiwan Agricultural Research Institute keeps the National Plant Genetic Resources Center, which began work in October 1993. Seeds are dried first and then sealed and kept cold and dry. The long-term storeroom is held at 12 degrees below zero Celsius. By the end of 2005 the center was keeping 68,211 samples of crop plants, ready to be woken when someone needs them.
cards.body_zh: 在台中霧峰，農業試驗所設有「國家作物種原中心」，1993 年 10 月開始運作。種子先經過乾燥，再密封起來，存放在又冷又乾的地方；長期庫的溫度保持在攝氏零下 12 度。到 2005 年底，中心保存的作物種原有 68,211 份，等到有人需要的時候，再把它們叫醒。

myths.myth_en: A dry seed is dead.
myths.myth_zh: 乾的種子是死的。
myths.fact_en: It is alive and asleep. Given water, warmth, and air, it can grow.
myths.fact_zh: 它是活的，只是睡著了。有了水、溫度和空氣，它就能生長。

myths.myth_en: A seed needs sunlight to start growing.
myths.myth_zh: 種子要曬到太陽才會開始長。
myths.fact_en: Many seeds start in the dark, under the soil. The light is needed later, by the leaves.
myths.fact_zh: 很多種子在土裡、在黑暗中就能開始長。光是後來葉子才需要的。

myths.myth_en: You must plant a seed the right way up.
myths.myth_zh: 種子一定要擺正了種。
myths.fact_en: The root finds its way down and the shoot finds its way up, however the seed lies.
myths.fact_zh: 不管種子怎麼躺，根都會自己往下，芽都會自己往上。

myths.myth_en: The more water, the better.
myths.myth_zh: 水愈多愈好。
myths.fact_en: A seed under water gets too little oxygen. It needs damp soil with air in it.
myths.fact_zh: 泡在水裡的種子得不到足夠的氧氣。它需要的是潮溼、而且含有空氣的土。

tricks.body_en: Coat, tiny plant, stored food.
tricks.body_zh: 種皮、小植物、存好的養分。

tricks.body_en: Water, warmth, and air.
Gravity tells it which is which.
tricks.body_zh: 重力告訴它哪邊是哪邊。

tricks.body_en: Leaves must open before the lunch is gone.
tricks.body_zh: 便當吃完之前，葉子要展開。

materials.en: A clear jar, paper towels, and water
materials.zh: 一個透明的罐子、幾張紙巾和水

materials.en: Four dried beans, such as mung beans or red beans
materials.zh: 四顆乾豆子，例如綠豆或紅豆

steps.en: Roll the paper towels and line the inside of the jar. Wet them well, and pour away any water that collects at the bottom.
steps.zh: 把紙巾捲起來，貼在罐子的內壁上。把紙巾澆溼，再把積在底部的水倒掉。

steps.en: Push the beans down between the paper and the glass, each one lying a different way: up, down, and sideways.
steps.zh: 把豆子塞進紙巾和玻璃之間，每一顆擺的方向都不一樣：朝上、朝下、橫著放。

steps.en: Keep the paper damp. Draw each bean every day for a week.
steps.zh: 讓紙巾一直保持潮溼。連續一個星期，每天把每一顆豆子畫下來。

steps.en: Which part came out first? Which way did the roots go? Did it matter how the bean was lying?
steps.zh: 最先出來的是哪個部分？根往哪個方向長？豆子怎麼擺有沒有差別？

activities.tip_en: When the roots are a few centimeters long, turn the whole jar on its side and leave it for two more days. Watch what the tips of the roots do. Do not eat the beans from this activity.
activities.tip_zh: 等根長到幾公分長，把整個罐子放倒，再放兩天，看根的尖端會怎麼做。這個活動用過的豆子不要吃。

materials.en: Two small cups with damp cotton or soil, and six mung beans
materials.zh: 兩個小杯子，裝上溼棉花或土，還有六顆綠豆

materials.en: A cardboard box that covers one cup completely
materials.zh: 一個可以把其中一杯完全罩住的紙箱

steps.en: Put three beans in each cup and keep both cups damp.
steps.zh: 每個杯子放三顆豆子，兩杯都保持潮溼。

steps.en: Leave one cup by a bright window. Cover the other with the box.
steps.zh: 一杯放在明亮的窗邊，另一杯用紙箱罩起來。

steps.en: After a week, measure the tallest plant in each cup, and write down the color of its stem and leaves.
steps.zh: 一個星期之後，量一量每一杯裡最高的那一株，並記下莖和葉子的顏色。

steps.en: Which plants are taller? Which look healthier? Are those the same plants?
steps.zh: 哪一杯的植物比較高？哪一杯看起來比較健康？是同一杯嗎？

activities.tip_en: The plants in the dark will probably be taller, and that does not mean they are doing better. Now put them by the window too, and see how many days it takes for them to turn green.
activities.tip_zh: 暗處的植物很可能比較高，但這不代表它們長得比較好。現在把它們也移到窗邊，看看要幾天才會變綠。

sources.en: A seed is a plant structure containing an embryo and stored nutrients in a protective coat; orchid seeds are the smallest, with about one million seeds per gram
sources.zh: 種子是在保護性種皮內含有胚與儲存養分的植物構造；蘭花種子最小，每公克約一百萬顆

sources.en: The most important outside factors for germination are the right temperature, water, oxygen or air, and sometimes light or darkness; the uptake of water swells the seed and breaks the coat; seeds have a temperature range within which they will germinate; oxygen is used in respiration, the seedling's main source of energy until it grows leaves; a seed buried too deeply or in waterlogged soil can be starved of oxygen
sources.zh: 發芽最重要的外在條件是合適的溫度、水、氧氣（空氣），有時還要光或黑暗；吸水使種子膨脹、種皮破裂；種子各有願意發芽的溫度範圍；在長出葉子之前，幼苗主要靠需要氧氣的呼吸作用取得能量；埋得太深或土壤積水的種子會缺氧

sources.en: The radicle, the embryonic root, is the first part of a seedling to emerge from the seed, and it grows downward
sources.zh: 胚根是幼苗最先從種子冒出來的部分，並且往下生長

sources.en: The cotyledons hold the stored food of the seed; as it is used up they may turn green or wither as the first true leaves take over
sources.zh: 子葉儲存種子的養分；養分用完後，子葉可能變綠行光合作用，或在真葉接手後枯萎

sources.en: Seed dormancy prevents seeds from germinating during unsuitable conditions
sources.zh: 種子休眠使種子不會在不適合的環境條件下發芽

sources.en: Charles Darwin was one of the first to document that roots grow toward gravity and stems away from it; a potted plant laid on its side turns its growing stem upward; dense starch-filled statoliths in the root cap are one way plants sense gravity
sources.zh: 達爾文是最早以科學方式記錄「根向地、莖背地」的人之一；橫放的盆栽，莖的生長部位會轉向上方；根冠裡沉降的澱粉體（平衡石）是植物感知重力的方式之一

sources.en: Seedlings grown without light have long, weak stems and a pale yellow color and lack chlorophyll; this raises the chance of reaching a light source from under the soil
sources.zh: 在無光下生長的幼苗莖細長、顏色淡黃、缺少葉綠素（黃化）；這能提高從土裡伸到有光處的機會

sources.en: Mung bean sprouts are grown by watering sprouted beans in the shade until the stems grow long
sources.zh: 綠豆芽的種法：把發芽的綠豆放在遮蔭處持續澆水，直到下胚軸伸長

sources.en: Date palm seeds found in a jar at Masada in 1963–1965 were radiocarbon dated to between 155 BC and 64 CE; one was sprouted in 2005 and the palm was named Methuselah
sources.zh: 1963–1965 年在馬薩達一個罐子裡發現的椰棗種子，碳十四定年為西元前 155 年到西元 64 年之間；2005 年其中一顆成功發芽，取名瑪土撒拉

sources.en: A 1,300-year-old sacred lotus seed recovered from a dry lake bed in northeastern China was grown in 1995
sources.zh: 中國東北乾涸湖床出土、約 1,300 年的古蓮子，於 1995 年的研究中成功發芽

sources.en: The National Plant Genetic Resources Center began operating in October 1993; by the end of 2005 it held 68,211 accessions; seeds are dried, sealed, and stored cold and dry, with the long-term store at −12 °C
sources.zh: 國家作物種原中心於民國 82 年 10 月開始營運；94 年底保存作物種原 68,211 份；種子乾燥後密封，在低溫低濕下存放，長期庫為 −12 ℃
sources.src: 農業部〈國家作物種原中心及水稻功能基因研究種原之保存〉（農業試驗所） Ministry of Agriculture, Taiwan
